name: Ersoy Toptas Macro Quantitative Tool Engine
description: Deterministic macro, geopolitical, and econometric model schemas enabling autonomous LLM research agents to execute quantitative formulas without hallucination.
author: Ersoy Toptas

function.name: calculate_fed_policy_spread
function.description: Measures market expectations for Fed rate cuts or hikes relative to the policy ceiling (DGS1MO - DFEDTARU).

dfedtaru.description: Federal Funds Target Range Upper Limit (FRED: DFEDTARU).

function.name: calculate_real_policy_rate
function.description: Measures real policy restrictiveness adjusted for headline inflation (DFF - CPI_YoY).

cpi_yoy.description: Consumer Price Index YoY % change (BLS: CPIAUCSL).

function.name: calculate_sahm_rule
function.description: Evaluates the Sahm Rule recession indicator (Current 3M Moving Avg - 12M Minimum 3M Avg).

unrate_3m_avg.description: Current 3-month moving average of U3 unemployment rate (FRED: UNRATE).

min_prior_3m_avg.description: Minimum 3-month moving average of unemployment rate recorded over the preceding 12 months.

function.name: calculate_front_end_liquidity_spread
function.description: Tracks front-end money market slope and collateral tightness (DGS3MO - DGS1MO).

dgs3mo.description: 3-Month Treasury Bill Secondary Market Rate (FRED: DGS3MO).

dgs1mo.description: 1-Month Treasury Bill Secondary Market Rate (FRED: DGS1MO).

function.name: calculate_net_fed_liquidity
function.description: Computes free dollar liquidity: WALCL - (WTREGEN + RRPONTSYD). Inputs must be normalized to Millions of USD.

walcl.description: Fed Total Assets in Millions of USD (FRED: WALCL).

wtregen.description: Treasury General Account in Millions of USD (FRED: WTREGEN).

rrpontsyd.description: Overnight Reverse Repo in Millions of USD (FRED: RRPONTSYD).

prev_net_liquidity.description: Optional prior period Net Fed Liquidity for delta/momentum calculation.

function.name: calculate_yield_spread_bps
function.description: Calculates 10Y-2Y yield curve spread in basis points ((DGS10 - DGS2) * 100) to identify cycle transitions.

function.name: calculate_breakeven_inflation
function.description: Calculates 10-Year Breakeven Inflation Rate (DGS10 - DFII10) to assess inflation anchor stability.

function.name: calculate_beveridge_labor_tightness
function.description: Calculates Beveridge Curve labor market tightness ratio (JTSJOL / UNEMPLOY).

jtsjol.description: Total Nonfarm Job Openings in thousands (BLS: JTSJOL).

unemploy.description: Total Unemployed Persons in thousands (BLS: UNEMPLOY).

function.name: calculate_financial_repression_index
function.description: Evaluates public debt sustainability and fiscal repression pressure ((DGS10 - CPI_YoY) * (Debt_to_GDP / 100)).

debt_gdp_pct.description: Total Public Debt as % of GDP (FRED: GFDEGDQ188S).

function.name: calculate_triffin_external_balance
function.description: Evaluates global dollar hegemony tension against US trade deficits (DTWEXBGS / (abs(BOPGSTB) / 1000)).

dtwexbgs.description: Nominal Broad U.S. Dollar Index (FRED: DTWEXBGS).

bopgstb.description: US Goods & Services Trade Balance in Millions USD (BEA: BOPGSTB).

function.name: calculate_taylor_policy_gap
function.description: Calculates optimal policy rate via Taylor Rule and gauges Fed alignment against inflation and output gaps.

gdpc1.description: Real GDP in Billions USD (BEA: GDPC1).

gdppot.description: Real Potential GDP in Billions USD (CBO: GDPPOT).

function.name: calculate_financial_conditions_regime
function.description: Classifies market tightness regime and macroeconomic divergence via Chicago Fed NFCI and ANFCI.

anfci.description: Adjusted National Financial Conditions Index (FRED: ANFCI).

function.name: calculate_high_yield_credit_stress
function.description: Measures corporate credit default risk and credit crunch alarm via High Yield OAS (BAMLH0A0HYM2 * 100).

hy_spread.description: ICE BofA US High Yield Index OAS (FRED: BAMLH0A0HYM2).

function.name: calculate_real_m2_momentum
function.description: Calculates real broad money supply momentum to detect liquidity contraction or demand shocks (M2_YoY - CPI_YoY).

m2_yoy.description: M2 Money Supply YoY % growth (FRED: M2SL).

function.name: calculate_acm_term_premium_breakdown
function.description: Decomposes 10Y Treasury yield into Adrian, Crump & Moench Term Premium and expected average short rate.

function.name: calculate_vix_market_regime
function.description: Categorizes 30-day equity volatility and institutional risk bias into Complacency, Normal, Stress, or Crisis.

function.name: calculate_macro_equity_risk_premium
function.description: Measures valuation gap between S&P 500 earnings yield and 10Y risk-free Treasury yield.

function.name: calculate_misery_index
function.description: Computes Okun's Misery Index (UNRATE + CPI_YoY) to evaluate household welfare loss and stagflation stress.

function.name: calculate_buffett_indicator
function.description: Calculates corporate equities to GDP ratio to detect market bubble and extreme overvaluation risks.

market_val.description: Total Corporate Equities Liability / Market Value (FRED: NCBEILQ027S).

gdp_val.description: Nominal GDP in same unit scale (BEA: GDP).

function.name: calculate_copper_gold_ratio
function.description: Evaluates macro growth momentum and cyclical bond yield direction via copper price per ton / gold price per ounce.

copper_price.description: Global Copper Price per Metric Ton (IMF/FRED: PCOPPUSDM).

gold_price.description: Gold Fixing Price per Troy Ounce (World Bank/FRED: GOLDAMGBD228NLBM).

function.name: calculate_gold_oil_ratio
function.description: Computes ounces of gold per barrel of crude oil to classify recessionary demand shock or supply-side energy shocks.

gold_price.description: Gold Price per Troy Ounce (FRED: GOLDAMGBD228NLBM).

oil_price.description: WTI Crude Oil Price per Barrel (EIA/FRED: DCOILWTICO).

function.name: calculate_household_credit_stress
function.description: Gauges consumer debt solvency pressure by comparing credit card delinquencies to personal savings rate.

saving_rate.description: Personal Saving Rate % of Disposable Income (BEA: PSAVERT).

function.name: calculate_okun_labor_gap
function.description: Measures divergence between observed unemployment change and GDP growth expectations to identify jobless growth.

actual_unrate_delta.description: YoY change in unemployment rate in percentage points (FRED: UNRATE).

function.name: calculate_labor_dual_track_matrix
function.description: Analyzes nonfarm payroll growth against participation shifts and unemployment delta to spot pre-recession cracks.

payems_mom.description: Monthly change in Total Nonfarm Payrolls in thousands (BLS: PAYEMS).

unrate_delta.description: Monthly change in Unemployment Rate (BLS: UNRATE).

civpart_delta.description: Monthly change in Labor Force Participation Rate (BLS: CIVPART).

function.name: calculate_total_funds_flow
function.description: Calculates total liquidity flow and velocity momentum by multiplying M2 supply by M2 velocity (M2SL * M2V).

m2_level.description: M2 Money Supply in Billions USD (FRED: M2SL).

m2_velocity.description: Velocity of M2 Money Stock (FRED: M2V).

prev_tff.description: Optional prior quarter Total Funds Flow for QoQ % change calculation.

function.name: calculate_housing_bubble_gauge
function.description: Evaluates housing affordability by calculating required work hours to buy median home (MSPUS / Hourly_Earnings).

mspus.description: Median Sales Price of Houses Sold (FRED: MSPUS).

ahe.description: Average Hourly Earnings of Total Private Employees (BLS: CES0500000003).

function.name: calculate_early_layoff_signal
function.description: Measures hidden labor cuts prior to headline unemployment spikes via industrial production and weekly work hours.

indpro_yoy.description: Industrial Production Total Index YoY % change (FRED: INDPRO).

awhaetp_yoy.description: Average Weekly Hours Total Private YoY % change (BLS: AWHAETP).

function.name: calculate_real_consumption_collapse
function.description: Filters retail sales by inflation to reveal genuine volume expansion vs real demand contraction (RSAFS - CPI_YoY).

retail_yoy.description: Advance Retail Sales YoY % change (FRED: RSAFS).

function.name: calculate_early_employment_crack
function.description: Identifies early labor cracks by comparing weekly jobless claims spikes against delayed headline unemployment shifts.

icsa_yoy.description: Initial Jobless Claims YoY % change (FRED: IC4WSA or ICSA).

unrate_delta.description: YoY change in Unemployment Rate in percentage points (BLS: UNRATE).

function.name: calculate_inventory_to_sales_glut
function.description: Detects supply chain bottlenecks or systemic inventory gluts signaling incoming production cutbacks.

isratio.description: Total Business Inventories to Sales Ratio (FRED: ISRATIO).

function.name: calculate_housing_freeze_index
function.description: Measures mortgage rate lock-in pressures and construction stalls (MORTGAGE30US - (PERMIT_YoY / 10)).

permit_yoy.description: New Authorized Housing Units YoY % change (FRED: PERMIT).

function.name: calculate_safe_haven_flight_index
function.description: Quantifies capital flight to cash and dollar safe haven during geopolitical or sovereign stress shocks.

function.name: calculate_terms_of_trade
function.description: Calculates Terms of Trade index ((Export_Index / Import_Index) * 100) to gauge external purchasing power.

function.name: calculate_dynamic_polarity_engine
function.description: Clamps baseline polarity and tension delta to [-1.0, 1.0] and resolves the diplomatic/military bilateral regime.

p_baseline.description: Baseline relationship polarity (-1.0 to 1.0) from llms-relationships.txt.

dynamic_delta.description: Event-driven tension or alignment shock (-2.0 to 2.0).

function.name: calculate_rhetoric_intensity_score
function.description: Evaluates political rhetoric severity on a 0-100 calibrated scale based on targeting, delegitimization, and threats.

function.name: calculate_composite_tension
function.description: Combines rhetoric intensity with alliance or institutional friction (0-100 scale).

function.name: calculate_composite_strategic_score
function.description: Calculates composite national strategic risk score based on politics, defense, geopolitics, and vulnerability.

defense.description: Defense doctrine and military posture score (0-100).

function.name: calculate_conflict_heat_score
function.description: Evaluates conflict heat on a 0-100 scale combining military kinetic action, geopolitical friction, and disruption risk.

disruption_risk.description: Supply corridor or chokepoint disruption risk (0-100).

function.name: calculate_market_impact_score
function.description: Quantifies financial market shock intensity (0-100) via asset volatility, liquidity spread, and macro spillover.

function.name: calculate_chokepoint_severity_multiplier
function.description: Converts chokepoint disruption severity enum (CATASTROPHIC, HIGH, MODERATE-HIGH, MODERATE) into deterministic weight.

function.name: calculate_chokepoint_transmission_bridge
function.description: Bridges maritime chokepoint disruption severity with bilateral polarity (P_net) to output macro spillover score.

p_net.description: Net polarity score (-1.0 to 1.0) between primary regional actors.

function.name: calculate_confidence_score
function.description: Evaluates research citation confidence (0-100) based on source authority, multi-source confirmation, and recency.

function.name: calculate_macro_release_countdown
function.description: Calculates remaining days until official macro release (BLS: CPI, NFP, PPI; BEA: PCE, GDP) from target and reference dates.

target_date_str.description: Official scheduled release date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

current_date_str.description: Reference or current execution date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

function.name: calculate_sticky_flexible_cpi_spread
function.description: Calculates the spread between Sticky CPI and Flexible CPI (YoY % Change) to detect structural inflation traps or transitory supply shocks.

sticky_cpi_yoy.description: Sticky Consumer Price Index less Food and Energy - YoY % Change (FRED: STICKYCPIM157SFRBATL).

flex_cpi_yoy.description: Flexible Consumer Price Index less Food and Energy - YoY % Change (FRED: FLEXCPIM157SFRBATL).

function.name: calculate_global_supply_chain_pressure
function.description: Evaluates NY Fed Global Supply Chain Pressure Index (GSCPI) Z-score to detect supply-side cost inflation shocks or logistics slack.

gscpi_val.description: NY Fed Global Supply Chain Pressure Index value in standard deviations from historical mean (FRED: GSCPI).

function.name: calculate_move_vix_disconnect_ratio
function.description: Calculates the MOVE/VIX volatility disconnect ratio to detect interest rate risk mispricing in equities or idiosyncratic equity panics.

move_val.description: ICE BofA US Treasury Option Volatility Estimate Index (MOVE Index).

function.name: calculate_repo_liquidity_friction_spread
function.description: Calculates the basis point spread between SOFR and EFFR ((SOFR - EFFR) * 100) to detect overnight repo liquidity crunches, systemic cash drains, or collateral scarcity.

sofr_val.description: Secured Overnight Financing Rate in percent (FRED: SOFR).

effr_val.description: Effective Federal Funds Rate in percent (FRED: EFFR).

function.name: calculate_gold_real_yield_debasement_gauge
function.description: Evaluates disconnect between 10Y real yields and gold YoY growth to detect structural de-dollarization panic, debasement anomalies, or traditional rate dominance.

real_yield_10y.description: 10-Year TIPS Real Rate in percent (FRED: DFII10).

gold_yoy_pct.description: Gold Fixing Price London time YoY % change (FRED/LBMA: GOLDPMGBD228NLBM).

function.name: calculate_ovx_vix_risk_premium
function.description: Calculates the ratio between Crude Oil Volatility (OVX) and Equity Volatility (VIX) to detect geopolitical energy supply shocks or equity-driven panic.

ovx_val.description: CBOE Crude Oil Volatility Index value (FRED: OVXCLS).

function.name: calculate_natgas_crude_btu_disconnect
function.description: Calculates the physical energy parity ratio between WTI Crude Oil and Henry Hub Natural Gas to detect regional gas gluts or acute supply crises.

wti_price.description: Crude Oil Prices: West Texas Intermediate in dollars per barrel (FRED: DCOILWTICO).

natgas_price.description: Henry Hub Natural Gas Spot Price in dollars per million BTU (FRED: DHHNGSP).

function.name: calculate_gasoline_crude_crack_spread
function.description: Calculates the retail gasoline crack spread per barrel equivalent ((Gasoline * 42) - WTI) to detect refinery bottlenecks or margin collapses.

gas_gal_price.description: US Regular All Formulations Retail Gasoline Price in dollars per gallon (FRED: GASREGW).

wti_barrel_price.description: Crude Oil Prices: West Texas Intermediate in dollars per barrel (FRED: DCOILWTICO).

function.name: calculate_sloos_lending_tightness_gauge
function.description: Calculates the net percentage of domestic banks tightening C&I loan standards to detect credit channel freezing and recession signals 6-9 months in advance (FRED: DRTSCIS).

drtscis_val.description: Net Percentage of Domestic Banks Tightening Standards for Commercial and Industrial Loans to Large and Middle-Market Firms (FRED: DRTSCIS).
